metadata.name: wframe
metadata.description: (state, active, ...contents) - render ONE window's chrome around the ACTIVE tab's content (contents[active]): titlebar (icon + name + minimize/fullscreen/close), a tab strip when the window has >=2 tabs, the body, and a resize grip. `state` is the window state object { x,y,w,h,z,min,max,closed,title,icon,tabs:[{ref,title,icon}],active,dockedIn }; `active` is win.active; `contents` is one value per tab (the frame formula passes each tab's content cel). A window whose state has dockedIn set self-hides (its host renders it). Content-AGNOSTIC: a tab's content may be a sheet grid, a wasmcanvas, or any winapp body, so heterogeneous windows tab together.

metadata.name: wopen
metadata.description: (id, title, body, where?) - genesis a SELF-MOUNTING window: a content cel (= body, the app render), a state cel (one tab = its own content), and a frame cel `(mount '.origin' (wframe <state> win.active <content>))` that mounts itself into the desktop. `where` = geom(x,y,w,h) sizes it. There is NO separate desktop renderer - each top-level window draws itself; dock one into another with window.dock to tab them together.

metadata.name: window.grab
metadata.description: pointerdown on a titlebar: capture the pointer + record the move offset into window.drag.

metadata.name: window.move
metadata.description: pointermove while dragging: write the window state cel's x/y.

metadata.name: window.grabResize
metadata.description: pointerdown on the resize grip: capture + record the size offset into window.drag (resize mode).

metadata.name: window.resizeMove
metadata.description: pointermove while resizing: write the window state cel's w/h (clamped to a minimum).

metadata.name: window.drop
metadata.description: pointerup: clear the transient window.drag state.

metadata.name: window.raise
metadata.description: pointerdown anywhere in a window: focus it (win.active) and bump it to the top of the z-order (win.topz).

metadata.name: window.min
metadata.description: toggle the window's minimized flag (the frame hides; a launcher restores it).

metadata.name: window.max
metadata.description: toggle fullscreen: when set the frame fills the viewport.

metadata.name: window.close
metadata.description: the red X: runs EACH tab's <seg>.flush contract cel (every tab is an app with its own save-then-teardown), then drops the window. A tab's flush is `<seg>.flush` derived from its content ref (or tab.flush).

metadata.name: window.stop
metadata.description: pointerdown on a titlebar/tab BUTTON: stopPropagation so the click does not start a window/tab drag.

metadata.name: window.tab
metadata.description: ({ref, index}) select a tab: set the window state cel's active index.

metadata.name: window.tabClose
metadata.description: ({ref, index}) close one tab: remove it from the window's tabs; closing the last tab closes the window.

metadata.name: window.dock
metadata.description: ({into, win}) COMBINE windows: pull an existing window `win` in as a tab of `into` (it is marked dockedIn → self-hides; the host renders it; tear-off restores it). Or ({into, tab}) append a raw tab { ref:<contentCel>, title, icon }. Rebuilds the host's self-mounting frame so it references the new content. Lets a sheet + DOOM share one tabbed frame.

metadata.name: window.reorder
metadata.description: ({ref, from, to}) move a tab within a window's tab order.

metadata.name: window.undock
metadata.description: ({ref, index}) TEAR OFF a tab (inverse of window.dock): remove it from `ref` + rebuild its frame. If the tab backs a real window (docked via window.dock), RESTORE it (clear dockedIn → it self-mounts again); otherwise mint a fresh standalone window + add it to win.list.

metadata.name: window.tabGrab
metadata.description: pointerdown on a tab chip: record the grab (window.tabdrag) so a later move can reorder or a release outside can tear off.
